changes: Date verified: VS 1900 and ŚS 1765 agree (both give 1843 CE); Pauṣa śukla 8 falls about late December 1843. Added the ŚS year to the notes.
Tithi normalized as 8 (aṣṭamī). 'myāṃ' is the locative ending attached to the tithi, not a separate word.

Notes: added a tentative reading of 'utprabhātīpayonāmaka' as a garbled 'upretī-pada-nāmaka' ('bearing the surname Upretī'), a Nepali Brahmin clan name, and flagged that the phrase 'idaṃ pusta(ka)' is left incomplete with no owner named.

notes: The two eras agree: VS 1900 − 57 = 1843 and ŚS 1765 + 78 = 1843. Pauṣa śukla 8 falls about late December 1843 CE. 'utprabhātīpayonāmaka (!)' is corrupt. It may be a garbled 'upretī-pada-nāmaka', meaning 'bearing the surname Upretī', which would make Durgādatta an Upretī Brahmin. This reading is tentative, so the name is not added to titles. 'idaṃ pustam' (for pustakam) begins an ownership statement but names no owner; possibly text is missing. The text is attributed to the sage Garga ('gargokta'), a legendary figure, so he is not listed as a person. The title in the colophon reads 'pallīpatanaśaraṭātohaṇa' (for -śaraṭārohaṇa, 'falling of the lizard and climbing of the chameleon'); the catalogue title is a corrupt form of this.
